name: Neutral CT directional-reference interface
summary: Provides the defined polarity and direction reference for a neutral-current protection input.
description: Provides the defined polarity and direction reference for a neutral-current protection input. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Neutral CT polarity” at the input and “Directional current reference” at the output. Directional logic also needs its selected polarising quantity.
